# What does a wedding film really pay per hour?

> Free calculator for wedding and event videographers: package price, shoot, edit and revision hours, second shooter, travel, gear and fees become your true hourly rate, profit per booking, the minimum package price for a target rate, and how edit hours erode it. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
